5671.title: Completed replies rejected by terminal-turn projection
5671.rootCauseOneLine: The closed-turn guard rejects authoritative completed assistant items along with late streaming deltas.

prReviews.topFinding: Reopening the turn can admit later deltas for other items; linked code was not executed.

5671.proposedFix: Admit unfinalized final text updates while retaining closed-turn status, late-delta suppression, and item-level deduplication.
5671.caveats: Repeated directly in two trusted-base checkouts; live provider timing and private thread history were not tested. Reproduction code and assertion output are inline.
